facts.text: The module is a wrapper class for the DMM Benning MM12
The information request is the fixed frame 55 55 00 00 AA and the display request is 55 55 01 00 AB
The function table maps codes 0x00 to 0x31 to a measuring mode and an SI base unit
The range multiplier tables are indexed by the range code and differ per measuring function
getDeviceInfos sends the information frame, reads 57 bytes and validates the reply 0x55550034
getDeviceInfos returns the model name, serial number, model ID and firmware version
getMeasurement_baseUnits sends the display frame, reads 17 bytes and validates the reply 0x5555010C
The MSB of the function and range codes marks auto or manual selection and is masked before lookup
getMeasurement_baseUnits returns the function name, the value and its SI base unit
The display unit is bits 7..3 and the display multiplier is bits 2..0 of the scope code
getMeasurement_humanUnits returns the value in the unit shown on the display
The three-byte measurement value is decoded as an unsigned little-endian integer (signed=False)
The comment above the three-byte measurement field calls it a 24bit signed integer
The serial port is opened at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit and a 2 s timeout
openConnection and closeConnection are the open and close methods of the serial port
